name: uppercase-story-metadata-freshness
title: Treat story evidence metadata as non-material regardless of Docs casing
description: Evidence freshness currently treats uppercase Docs/story paths from host projects as material code changes after committing Koala story evidence. This creates a stale-evidence loop for external repos such as the Mac app. Normalize story metadata path matching so Docs/story and docs/story are excluded from material hash/freshness decisions, and add regression tests.
